extraction_method: official manufacturer PDF; pdftotext -layout plus manual structuring; no vendor SPICE model used

temperature.conditions: Unless otherwise specified VIN = VR + 1 V, ILOAD = 100 uA, COUT = CIN = 1 uF X7R, TA = 25 degC
temperature.column_semantics: table applies at 25 degC unless otherwise stated

minimum_25c.conditions: VIN = 4.3 V, ILOAD = 100 uA, COUT = CIN = 1 uF X7R, TA = 25 degC
minimum_25c.page_reference: p. 2 Output Voltage Regulation row, MIN column

typical_25c.conditions: same table conditions; nominal VR = 3.3 V
typical_25c.page_reference: p. 2 Output Voltage Regulation row and note 2, TYP column
typical_25c.column_semantics: VR +/-0.4%; nominal centre used as fitted target

maximum_25c.page_reference: p. 2 Output Voltage Regulation row, MAX column

line_regulation_per_volt.conditions: VIN = VR + 1 V to 6 V, ILOAD = 100 uA, TA = 25 degC
line_regulation_per_volt.page_reference: p. 2 Line Regulation row, TYP column
line_regulation_per_volt.column_semantics: published magnitude 0.75%/V; fitted with positive slope convention

line_regulation_span.conditions: VIN = 4.3 V to 6 V for VR = 3.3 V
line_regulation_span.page_reference: p. 2 Line Regulation row, TYP column

load_regulation.conditions: ILOAD = 0.1 mA to 250 mA for VR >= 2.5 V, constant junction temperature
load_regulation.page_reference: p. 2 Load Regulation row, TYP column and note 4

dropout_voltage.conditions: ILOAD = 250 mA; output reduced 2% from value at VR + 1 V differential
dropout_voltage.page_reference: p. 2 Dropout Voltage row and note 5, TYP column

short_circuit_current.conditions: VIN = VR + 1 V, VOUT = GND, measured 10 ms after short
short_circuit_current.page_reference: p. 2 Output Short Circuit Current row, TYP column

quiescent_current.conditions: IL = 0 mA, VIN = VR + 1 V, TA = 25 degC
quiescent_current.page_reference: p. 2 Input Quiescent Current row, TYP column

minimum.page_reference: p. 2 Input Operating Voltage row, MIN column

maximum.page_reference: p. 2 Input Operating Voltage row, MAX column
